method: Whole-file manual reading of RecoveryNtfs.h/cpp,755 lines; pinned bytes verified. Original BitmapFree compiled with primitive aliases and Failure adapter.

runtime_controls.scope: All65536two-byte bitmaps times153valid offset/count pairs checked against independent per-bit oracle; three invalid ranges require ERROR_INVALID_DATA.
runtime_controls.adapters: BYTE uint8_t, ULONGLONG uint64_t, synthetic Failure with error13; original BitmapFree body unchanged. No Windows API executed.

findings: Mapping-pair decoder validates nibble widths, signed relative offsets, logical coverage, physical bounds and overlap while preserving sparse holes. Missing terminator fails. Record parser validates512byte fixup trailers before restoring a private copy.

Recovery accepts unnamed resident/nonresident main data and sparse holes; attribute lists, reparse/encrypted records, compression and incomplete extents are unsupported. Multiple main data attributes disable support; named streams are not recovered.

MFT mapping uses retrieval pointers, bounds individual extents and rechecks mapping after scan and before record validation. Raw read views borrow a reusable buffer and expire after next raw read; concurrent instance use is not synchronized here.

Scan reads4MiB batches, retains deleted usable candidates and directory ancestry, marks missing/reused/cyclic paths uncertain using parent sequence numbers. Initial scan allocation cache is not fresh proof at recovery time.

BitmapFree exhaustive controls establish bit-range logic for two-byte inputs only, not DeviceIoControl response handling or whole NTFS recovery. ClustersFree handles returned bitmap origin and queries fresh pages when no scan cache supplied.

RecoverFile checks saved MFT record and free allocation, reads bounded chunks with fresh allocation before/after, zero-fills sparse/uninitialized tails and verifies final byte count. Allocation state does not establish historic data integrity or an immutable source snapshot.

Final ValidateRecord/allocation checks occur before OutputFile Commit. Commit callback here checks pause/cancel only, unlike FAT/exFAT callbacks which revalidate metadata around flush. Changes during/after final flush are not revalidated by this NTFS callback.
limits: No raw device reads, recovered output, Windows IOCTL, malformed MFT corpus, mapping decoder runtime, source mutation or crash durability tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
